hero.headline: Caafimaadkaaga, Hawsheenna. Biruh Tena.
hero.subtext: Daryeelka caafimaad ee heer caalami ah oo ku salaysan qiyamka Itoobiya. Ballanqaadkaaga maanta qabso.
services.label: Takhasusyadeenna
services.heading: Daryeel gaar ah bukaanka kasta.
services.description: Baaritaannada caadiga ah ilaa habdhaqaaqyada adag, khubaradayadu waxay bixiyaan heer sare oo kasta.
services.generalMedicineDesc: Daryeelka caafimaad ee heer koowaad iyo ka hortagga cudurrada bukaannada da'da kasta.
services.pediatricsDesc: Daryeel gaar ah carruurta, caruurta yar iyo dhalinyarada dhakhaatiirta carruurta khabiirka ah.
services.gynecologyDesc: Adeegyada caafimaadka haweenka oo dhammaystiran laga bilaabo baaritaannada caadiga ah ilaa daryeelka uurka.
services.surgeryDesc: Habdhaqaaqyada qalliinka ee horumarsan oo ay fuliyaan dhakhaatiirta qalliinka ee shahaadada leh.
services.dermatologyDesc: Baaritaanka iyo daaweynta khabiirka ah ee xaaladaha maqaarka, timaha iyo cidiyaha.
services.ophthalmologyDesc: Daryeelka indhaha oo dhammaystiran laga bilaabo baaritaannada caadiga ah ilaa qalliinka adag.
doctors.label: Dhakhaatiirtayada Baro
doctors.heading: Khabiirka saxda ah ee adiga u habboon hel.
doctors.description: Magaca ama takhasusyada ku raadi si aad u hesho dhakhtarka saxda ah.
doctors.noResultsHint: Magac ama takhasusyo kale isku day.
doctors.error: Dhakhaatiirta soo dejin kari waayay. Fadlan mar kale isku day.

faq.label: Su'aal Ma Qabtaa?
faq.heading: Su'aalaha Inta Badan La Weydiiyo
faq.a1: Boggaankeenna ama xariiqda xaaladda degdeg ah ayaad ballanqaad ku qabsan kartaa. Dhakhtarkaaga dooro, taariikhda iyo wakhtiga dooro, ballanqaadkaaga xaqiiji.
faq.a2: Haa, waxaan la shaqeynaa shirkadaha caymiska ee Itoobiya ee waaweyn.
faq.a3: Aqoonsiga saxda ah, kaarka caymiskaaga (haddii jiro) iyo diiwaannada caafimaad ee hore ee la xiriira booqashadaada keeni.
faq.q4: Ma jirtaa daryeelka xaaladda degdeg ah?
faq.a4: Haa, xariiqda xaaladda degdeg ah (+251 911 22 33 44) 24/7 ayay diyaar tahay.
faq.q5: Sidee diiwaannada caafimaadkayga u heli karaa?
faq.a5: Bukaannada is diiwaan geliyay waxay heli karaan diiwaannadooda caafimaad oo dhammaystiran boggaanka.
faq.a6: Rugaha caafimaadkayadu waxay furan yihiin Isniin–Jimce 8GH–6GH Sabti 9GH–2GH.
faq.q7: Ma bedeli karaa ama baabi'in karaa ballanqaadkayga?
faq.a7: Haa, ballanqaadkaaga 24 saacadood ka hor bedeli ama baabi'in kartaa.
